chunks: From him, from Sulaymān ibn Dāwūd, from ʿAlī ibn Abī Ḥamzah, from Abū Baṣīr, who said:
Abū ʿAbdillāh عليه السلام mentioned the beginning of the time and its merit, so I said, “How should I manage the eight rakʿahs?” He said, “Lighten them as much as you can.”

key_terms.أَوَّلَ الْوَقْتِ: the beginning of the prescribed prayer time
key_terms.الثَّمَانِي رَكَعَاتٍ: the eight rakʿahs being referred to in the report
key_terms.مَا اسْتَطَعْتَ: as much as you are able

ai.seo_question: How should one perform the eight rakʿahs when trying to pray at the beginning of the prayer time?
ai.summary: This hadith emphasizes the merit of performing salat at the beginning of its prescribed time. It also gives practical guidance that the recommended eight rakʿahs should be shortened as much as possible in order to preserve the virtue of praying early.
